name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-paid-ads-blue
title: Cyan halftone banner with a 'paid ads' folder and violet scribble
whatItIs: A wide cyan and white halftone banner with a manila folder labelled 'paid ads', a bright blue scribble burst behind it, a pixel cursor and six app icons.
whatItMeans: Crisp and digital; single-hue halftone feels like a blueprint.
techniques: Limit halftone to a single blue family.
Use a violet scribble as the accent.
Keep composition identical to other banners.
Surround the folder with app icons.

vocabulary.definition: A dot texture in one hue.
A rough burst behind an object.
App icons around a central item.
A service name on a folder.
